parameters.name: AcceptLanguage
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The name of the Microservices Engine (MSE) namespace.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun mse delete-swimming-lane --lane-id 229 --namespace default --accept-language zh --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun mse DeleteSwimmingLane --region cn-hangzhou --AcceptLanguage zh --LaneId 229 --Namespace default
